summary: Two-slice follow-on: foundation authorized get-by-id with additive OpenAPI/OCL/Vitest surfaces, then named missing/not-visible and unauthorized lookup failures without mutation; prior reserve/release/expire Features stay in force.
acceptance_of_whole:
Scenario: Reservation lookup covers authorized get-by-id and named failures
  Given the inventory reservation service for clients
  When clients exercise authorized soft-hold lookup by id, missing or not-visible lookup, and unauthorized lookup
  Then authorized lookup returns that hold's details without mutating stock or holds
  And missing/not-visible and unauthorized lookups fail with named domain errors without mutation
  And openapi/openapi.yaml documents additive lookup while prior reserve/release/expire operations remain
  And contracts/**/*.ocl and passing tests/contracts/** cover get-by-id success and named missing/unauthorized failures
  And payments, multi-warehouse, full IAM, UI, notifications, TTL extend, and list-by-SKU aggregates are not required

human_gate.reason: ChangeBrief scope is explicit; open_questions are non-blocking deferrals to OpenAPI/OCL apply; two property-level Scenarios map cleanly to in_scope and success_criteria without blocking ambiguity.

items.intent: Allow an authorized opaque principal to look up an existing visible soft-hold by id and receive its details without mutating stock or holds, establishing additive OpenAPI and UML OCL surfaces with derived Vitest coverage.
items.acceptance_criterion:
Scenario: Authorized lookup returns an existing visible soft-hold without mutation
  Given a reservation service with an existing visible soft-hold
  And an authorized opaque principal
  When the principal looks up that soft-hold by id
  Then the service returns that hold's details
  And stock and holds are unchanged
items.scenario_name: Authorized lookup returns an existing visible soft-hold without mutation

human_gate.reason: Authorized get-by-id success and additive OpenAPI/OCL surfaces are unambiguous; path/method deferred to apply.

items.intent: Fail soft-hold lookup with a named domain error and no stock/hold mutation when the hold is missing or not visible, or when the caller is unauthorized.
items.acceptance_criterion:
Scenario: Lookup fails with named domain errors without mutation for missing holds and unauthorized callers
  Given a reservation service with stock and soft-holds
  When lookup is attempted for a missing or not-visible soft-hold by an authorized principal, or for an existing soft-hold by an unauthorized caller
  Then the operation fails with a named domain error
  And stock and holds are unchanged
items.scenario_name: Lookup fails with named domain errors without mutation for missing holds and unauthorized callers

human_gate.reason: Named missing/not-visible and unauthorized lookup failures follow settled Brief assumptions; error JSON deferred to apply.
